name: ABP RentalForge
author: ABP Team

sections.description:
RentalForge is a powerful WooCommerce-based WordPress rental and booking plugin designed for property rentals, equipment rentals, vehicle rentals, and other rental businesses. Manage bookings, pricing, inventory, availability, and rental orders from a single dashboard.

Create flexible rental pricing with hourly, daily, monthly, or combined pricing models. Configure booking rules, rental durations, deposits, quantity limits, and availability schedules to match your business requirements.

RentalForge includes advanced property management tools, inventory control, order management, client forms, additional services, FAQs, and global feature controls. Unused modules can be disabled globally to keep both the admin dashboard and frontend clean and lightweight.

Whether you manage vacation rentals, construction equipment, vehicles, offices, event equipment, tools, or any other rentable products, RentalForge provides a fast, flexible, and user-friendly rental management solution powered by WooCommerce.

Built with WordPress coding standards, RentalForge is lightweight, developer-friendly, translation ready, responsive, and easy to customize.

✨ Why Choose RentalForge?

RentalForge is a powerful and flexible WooCommerce rental booking solution designed for businesses of all sizes. Whether you’re renting equipment, vehicles, properties, boats, offices, or event items, RentalForge provides everything you need to manage bookings, inventory, pricing, and customers from one place.
Whether you’re managing a small rental business or a large inventory-based company, RentalForge scales with your business.

🚀 Key Features

  • WooCommerce Powered – Fully integrated with WooCommerce for payments, taxes, coupons, and order management.
  • Complete Rental Management – Manage unlimited rental properties, equipment, vehicles, and booking resources from a single dashboard.
  • Feature Toggle System – Enable or disable any major feature globally. Disabled modules are completely removed from both the admin dashboard and frontend.
  • Flexible Pricing Engine – Create hourly, daily, monthly, or combined pricing models with automatic price calculation.
  • Advanced Inventory Management – Manage stock, quantity limits, reservations, and rental availability with ease.
  • Duplicate & Move Properties – Duplicate complete properties, copy property settings, or move rental configurations between WordPress posts.
  • Powerful Order Management – Manage bookings with advanced filters, pagination, customer search, and booking status tracking.
  • Global Configuration – Control booking settings, client forms, FAQs, additional services, Terms & Conditions, and other options from one place.
  • Responsive Property Listings – Display beautiful rental listings with image galleries, sliders, and shortcode support.
  • Guest Management – Store customer details and complete booking history.
  • Frontend Customization – Customize layouts with built-in CSS options and flexible slider settings.
  • Developer Friendly – Built with WordPress coding standards, hooks, filters, optimized database tables, and translation-ready architecture.
  • Multi-Currency Ready – Compatible with WooCommerce multi-currency solutions.
  • Fully Responsive – Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “RentalForge”.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual Installation via Upload

  1. Upload the abp-rentalforge.zip file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the “RentalForge” menu from the admin sidebar to start configuration.

Installation via FTP

  1. Download the abp-rentalforge.zip file.
  2. Extract the abp-rentalforge folder on your computer.
  3. Upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/ via FTP.
  4. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins dashboard.
sections.faq:
Can I duplicate a rental property?

Yes. RentalForge lets you duplicate an entire property or copy only its rental settings to another property.

Can I disable unused modules?

Yes. RentalForge includes a Global Feature Toggle System that allows you to completely disable unused modules from both the admin dashboard and frontend.

Can I use multiple pricing types?

Yes. You can enable multiple pricing options, but only one pricing rule can be active per post.

Is a deposit required?

No. Deposit is completely optional.

What is the default minimum quantity?

If not set, the default minimum quantity is 1.

Can I override unavailable days or weekends?

Yes. Special date settings allow you to override default availability rules.

How is monthly duration calculated?

By default, 1 month is calculated as 30 days.

Does the plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. RentalForge is designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme and includes responsive frontend templates.

Which payment gateways are supported?

RentalForge uses WooCommerce for payments, so all WooCommerce-supported gateways are available.

Can I manage multiple properties?

Yes. You can create unlimited properties, each with individual pricing, availability, and settings.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is fully translation-ready and compatible with standard WordPress localization tools.

Does it work in local environments like XAMPP?

Yes. RentalForge works perfectly in local development environments such as XAMPP or LocalWP.

Where can I get support?

You can ask questions in the WordPress support forum:
https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/abp-rentalforge/
Our team typically responds within 24–48 hours.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

This plugin does not collect or transmit any personal data by itself. Any customer or order information is stored within your WordPress and WooCommerce installation.
